UploadFolder.Name: Upload Folder
UploadFolder.Hint: The folder path where converted WebP images will be uploaded.

TargetJournal.Name: Target Journal
TargetJournal.Hint: The journal entry where uploaded images will be added as pages.

WebPQuality.Name: WebP Quality
WebPQuality.Hint: Quality of the WebP conversion (0.1 = lowest, 1.0 = highest).

includeWorldId.Name: Include World ID in path
includeWorldId.Hint: Adds a subfolder named with the current world ID.

subfolderByType.Name: Add Subfolder by Type
subfolderByType.Hint: When enabled, uploads go into image, video, or audio subfolders. SVG uploads always go into an svg subfolder.

ConvertMonotoneSvgToWhite.Name: Lighten Dark Monotone SVGs
ConvertMonotoneSvgToWhite.Hint: When enabled, dark grayscale monotone SVG uploads are saved on the light side for tinting.

KeepOriginalSvg.Name: Keep Original SVGs
KeepOriginalSvg.Hint: When enabled, originals for converted SVGs remain in svg while processed SVGs are saved in svg/converted.

StampAllUploads.Name: Time Stamp All Uploads
StampAllUploads.Hint: Converted files receive a unique stamp. Enable this to stamp all uploads.

ShowNotifications.Name: Show Notifications
ShowNotifications.Hint: Display notification messages when images are uploaded.

CreateJournalIfMissing.Name: Auto-Create Journal
CreateJournalIfMissing.Hint: Automatically create the target journal if it doesn't exist.

CreatePlaylistIfMissing.Name: Auto-Create Playlist
CreatePlaylistIfMissing.Hint: Automatically create the MiniUploader playlist for audio files if it doesn't exist.

Notifications.JournalNotFound: Target journal not found. Please configure in module settings.
Notifications.NoImagesDropped: No valid image files detected in drop
